summary: Iter 179 focused RETEST of the two iter-178 bulk-advance bugs. Backend: 4/4 pytest tests pass — (a) POST /api/advances/bulk with documents_not_required=false and no documents returns 400 and leaves ZERO orphan employee_advances rows AND creates NO approvals doc (approval-first reorder verified); (b) happy path (documents_not_required=true + reason) returns 200 with batch_no ADB-2026-00xx, both advances persisted with the correct approval_id/batch_no, and exactly one approval doc exists whose advance_ids match; (c) regression Manager OP (test_mop@erp.com) bulk with E-1001 + E-MOP-01 still returns 200 (no 403); (d) regression POST /api/advances/bulk/parse with a valid xlsx returns 2 valid rows and writes nothing. Frontend: verified the EmployeeSearchSelect re-open fix on /app/hr/advances — New Advance Request -> multi-mode-toggle -> multi-emp-select opened (51 options), picked Arjun Reddy (E-1001), then WITHOUT blurring clicked the same input: dropdown re-opened immediately (50 options), picked Deepa Nair (E-1004), multi-emp-list shows 2 rows; typing in the input also re-opens/filters the list (41 options for 'a'). All test data created this run was deleted (advances via API, 4 dangling bulk approvals via cleanup script, 0 payment-queue rows).

minor.issue: Deleting a bulk advance does not clean up (or re-point) its batch approval — after deleting both advances of a batch, the 'Bulk Advance ADB-…' approval doc survives with advance_ids pointing to non-existent rows. Reproduced twice this run; had to purge 4 dangling approvals manually. Low user impact but pollutes /app/approvals.

action_items: Optional (minor): when an advance is deleted, delete/adjust its bulk approval doc so no dangling 'Bulk Advance ADB-…' approvals remain.
critical_code_review_comments: advance_router.bulk_advance: approval-first ordering is correct now, but the write is still not atomic — if any db.employee_advances.insert_one fails mid-loop, the approval and a partial set of advances persist. Consider inserting the advances with insert_many after the gate, or wrap in a try/except that deletes the approval on failure.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Temporary: 2 bulk batches (admin ADB happy-path, mop ADB) + 1 rejected gate call; all advances and their approvals deleted after the run (verified 0 remaining TEST_iter179 rows, 0 dangling bulk approvals).

Reusable regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter179_bulk_advance_retest.py (self-cleaning via API delete; run /app/backend/tests/cleanup_iter179_approvals.py afterwards to purge dangling bulk approvals). UI testids: advance-new-btn, advance-create-dialog, multi-mode-toggle, multi-emp-panel, multi-emp-select, multi-emp-select-list, multi-remove-{i}, multi-total. Login testids: login-email / login-password / login-submit (email field is not type=email).
rca_of_the_issue: Iter178 bug 1: advances were inserted before insert_approval(), whose documents gate raises ApprovalDocumentsRequired -> 400, leaving orphan 'submitted' advances with a dangling approval_id. Fix (insert approval first) confirmed: after a 400 the advance count is unchanged and no approvals doc is added. Iter178 bug 2: EmployeeSearchSelect only opened on onFocus; after picking via onMouseDown(preventDefault) the input kept focus, so a subsequent click fired no focus event and the list stayed closed. Fix (onClick + open-on-change) confirmed in the browser.
